entry.title: Sturm-TP 0.1.2
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.

entry.title: Sturm-TP 0.1.0
entry.summary: Six-voice analog-style drum and synth voice for Akai MPC OS standalone devices (Force, MPC Live / One / X / Key), modelled on a classic drum machine's voice: two analog oscillators (saw, triangle, saw-tri, pulse) with sync and a sub oscillator, two sample oscillators that can bypass the filters, a resonant 2/4-pole lowpass that rings on its own, a highpass, feedback, five envelopes with delay and peak hold, two LFOs and eight modulation paths.
